_why: Organ-canary ratchet (2026-09-28). The canaries reported five dead organs and exited 0 unless asked to gate, so nothing ran them and nothing could. Gating outright would paint the gate red on day one -- the exact failure state/ci/guardrail_baseline.json exists to prevent ('red became the normal state, so a NEW red carried no information'). These five are RECORDED as known-dead so a SIXTH is caught the day it appears, and so each death carries an owner-visible reason instead of a silent zero.
_how_to_pay_down: Revive the organ, then DELETE its entry here in the same commit. The gate notices a baselined organ that has come back to life and asks for the entry to be removed -- it never fails you for fixing something.
